title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Image
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Image. A software piece that can be executed by a virtual or bare metal Compute service. It is a subclass of OperatingSystem and CodeArtifact in the source ontology; modeled here as a subclass of CodeArtifact per system_prompt.md single-parent guidance, inheriting CodeArtifact's (and transitively SoftwareResource's) properties, not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Image'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

fileSize.description: Relationship. Size of the image. Links to a MemorySize entity.

operatingSystem.description: Relationship. Resolvable link to the Gaia-X credential of the operating system offered by the image. Links to an OperatingSystem entity.

cpuReq.description: Relationship. CPU capabilities required to run the image. Links to a CPU entity.

gpuReq.description: Relationship. GPU capabilities required to run the image. Links to a GPU entity.

ramReq.description: Relationship. Minimal RAM size required to run the image. Links to a Memory entity.

videoRamSize.description: Relationship. Maximum RAM amount for the video image. Links to a MemorySize entity.

rootDiskReq.description: Relationship. Minimal root disk size required to run the image. Links to a Disk entity.

encryption.description: Relationship. Details on encryption of the image. Links to an Encryption entity.

secureBoot.description: Property. If true, instances only start with valid software signatures.

vPMU.description: Property. If true, virtual performance monitoring unit is enabled in the guest.

multiQueues.description: Property. If true, one queue set is used for each virtual CPU.

updateStrategy.description: Property. Provider's image update strategy details. Controlled-vocabulary value (UpdateStrategyEnum), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

licenseIncluded.description: Property. Indicates if the service fee includes a commercial license.

maintenance.description: Relationship. Maintenance capabilities of the image OS vendor. Links to a MaintenanceSubscription entity.
